question: When the heavier component in a mixture settles after water is added to it, the process is called ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**sedimentation.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• When the weighty particles in a mixture settle after water is added to it, the process is called **sedimentation.**
 
• The **particles that steady down throughout sedimentation** are called **sediments.**
 
• For example, in a mixture of **sand and water, sand steady down at the bottom. **
 
• It is explained as the separation procedure in which** solids are separated from the liquid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24d2f3d520e266a0ec936731321127a9bb059a3f4413d7c788b5b541aa3229fd.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Threshing** is the procedure of dissociation of grain from the stalk on which it develops and from the chaff or unit that covers it.
 
• **Sieving** permits the fine flour particles to pass through the holes of the sieve while the larger particles or impurities rest on the sieve. 
 
• **Yarning** is a informal procedure that mean the** sharing of stories and the development of knowledge**. ​
